01 / About

Research at the boundary of meaning and security.

KALI—Knowledge, Adversaries, Language & Intelligence—is led by Dr. Mithun Paul Saint-Germain. We develop practical and principled approaches to language technology, secure AI, and emerging computational paradigms. We care about systems that work beyond the benchmark: under distribution shift, adversarial pressure, and real-world access constraints.

02 / Research

Three connected directions

We build toward AI that is
capable, legible, and resilient.

R / 01

Language & reasoning

Natural language understanding, fact verification, causal models, and data-efficient transfer across domains.

  • NLP
  • Fact verification
  • Knowledge distillation
R / 02

Trustworthy & secure AI

Detecting prompt injection and behavioral drift, protecting AI agents, and applying machine learning to cyber defense.

  • Agent security
  • Prompt injection
  • Phishing detection
R / 03

Quantum language

Scalable quantum natural language processing, compositional models, and multilingual grammar-aware systems.

  • QNLP
  • Pregroup grammar
  • Multilingual systems
